svg.title: Two scatter plots of 1 − r, the base-to-instruct activation change, for 311 poles. Left, against the output-weight Fisher percentile: Spearman −0.326. Right, against the activation RMS percentile: −0.346. Partial Spearman of the Fisher with the RMS taken out: −0.030.
svg.text: Neurons that fire more move less, and the
output Fisher adds nothing beyond that
Left: each pole's output-weight Fisher percentile. Right: its activation RMS percentile. Both within the layer.
Spearman ρ with 1 − r: −0.326 and −0.346. With the RMS taken out, the Fisher's ρ is −0.030.
